properties.name: San Isidro Lowland Parcel A
properties.plain_language_action: Critical sub-canopy water pooling detected along micro-slope runoff channel. Dig targeted 30cm micro-drainage trenches on the eastern bund or execute early salvage harvest before root rot sets in.
properties.sms_alert: FIELD SHIFT ALERT: PL-01 (3.4ha, San Isidro) is HIGH Drowning Risk (88/100). Cut eastern micro-drainage trench or harvest mature rice early to stop root rot.

properties.name: San Isidro Creek-Edge Parcel B
properties.plain_language_action: High surface saturation pooling from upslope flow accumulation. Open southern spillway gate and clear silt from tertiary drainage canal immediately.
properties.sms_alert: FIELD SHIFT ALERT: PL-02 (2.8ha, San Isidro) is HIGH Drowning Risk (79/100). Open southern spillway and clear tertiary drainage canal to drain standing water.

properties.name: Mabuhay Mid-Slope Parcel C
properties.plain_language_action: Moderate surface wetness increase after 7-day GPM rainfall total. Inspect perimeter furrows and prepare bio-tillage cover crop seed for the post-harvest bare window.
properties.sms_alert: FIELD SHIFT WATCH: PL-03 (2.1ha, Mabuhay) at Moderate Risk (54/100). Clear perimeter furrows and monitor lower corners during incoming rain bands.

properties.name: Pacol Transition Terrace D
properties.plain_language_action: Rising soil moisture along terrace toe-slope. Keep cross-slope diversion ditches unobstructed to prevent sheet erosion.
properties.sms_alert: FIELD SHIFT WATCH: PL-04 (1.9ha, Pacol) at Watch Status (42/100). Keep cross-slope diversion ditches clear to prevent topsoil runoff.

properties.name: Carolina Upland Parcel E
properties.plain_language_action: Well-drained upper slope with minimal pooling risk. Ideal candidate for post-harvest nitrogen-fixing mungbean rotation.
properties.sms_alert: FIELD SHIFT CLEAR: PL-05 (3.5ha, Carolina) is LOW Risk (19/100). Normal field drainage; schedule post-harvest mungbean rotation.

rotation_strategies.name: Nitrogen-Fixing & Soil Restorative Rotation
rotation_strategies.mechanics: Integrates deep-rooted legumes during post-harvest bare-field windows identified via multi-year NDVI.
rotation_strategies.benefits: Restores soil organic matter, fixes atmospheric N2 to cut synthetic fertilizer purchases, and breaks root-knot nematode pest cycles.
rotation_strategies.risks_and_gaps: Verify local mungbean/cowpea seed supply and check plot soil pH compatibility with Municipal Agriculture Office.

rotation_strategies.name: Deep-Rooting & Erosion Control Cover Crop (Bio-Tillage)
rotation_strategies.mechanics: Plants deep-rooting brassicas or grasses across NASADEM high-velocity micro-slope runoff channels.
rotation_strategies.benefits: Creates sub-surface macro-pores that accelerate water infiltration, relieve surface ponding, and anchor topsoil against heavy rain.
rotation_strategies.risks_and_gaps: Evaluate local labor or forage harvesting equipment requirements before planting.

rotation_strategies.name: Water-Conserving & Heat-Tolerant Short-Cycle Rotation
rotation_strategies.mechanics: Transitions water-intensive cereal crops during dry windows to short-cycle, low-water-demand grains.
rotation_strategies.benefits: Lowers seasonal irrigation demand while avoiding flowering-stage heat stress and diversifying household cash income.
rotation_strategies.risks_and_gaps: Review local buyer demand and farmgate price stability with extension officers.
